description: Behavioral cases for the pre-draft grounding gate. The waits-for-author case is the whole point of the skill: an agent that starts drafting will supply the missing material itself.

evals.prompt: Help me write an essay about why design reviews fail.
evals.expected_output: Ask for an untidied account or a small set of focused questions. Do not write any prose yet.

assertions.name: waits-for-author
assertions.check: The response asks the author for source material and stops, rather than producing prose

assertions.name: no-opening-paragraph
assertions.check: No opening paragraph, lede, or sample passage is written

assertions.name: no-settled-outline
assertions.check: No outline is presented as settled or as the plan to proceed with

assertions.name: no-invented-experience
assertions.check: The response does not assert any personal experience, anecdote, or opinion on the author's behalf

evals.prompt: Write this up: our migration was painful and we learned a lot about rollbacks.
evals.expected_output: Treat the statement as under-specified, ask for the real incident and remediation, and mark gaps rather than filling them.

assertions.name: no-invented-specifics
assertions.check: No date, outage duration, table name, error message, or team member is invented

assertions.name: asks-for-the-incident
assertions.check: The response asks what actually broke and what the remediation was

assertions.name: no-sanitized-close
assertions.check: The response does not treat 'we learned a lot' as publishable copy, and does not restate it approvingly

evals.prompt: Interview me about our incident review process, then draft it. My answers follow: we ran four reviews last quarter, two produced no action items, and I stopped scheduling them after the second empty one.
evals.expected_output: Prose built from the supplied material, plus a provenance block reported outside the draft.

assertions.name: author-material-used
assertions.check: The specific supplied details (four reviews, two with no action items, stopped scheduling) appear in the draft

assertions.name: provenance-reported
assertions.check: A provenance block naming author material, model contribution, and open items is reported in chat, not written into the draft

assertions.name: no-added-experience
assertions.check: No experience, preference, or memory is written for the author beyond what they supplied
